channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Little Pine Returns to The Ryder Hotel With Holiday Pop-Up Experience
item.description: Little Pine, Charleston’s popular holiday installation, is back and brighter than ever at The Ryder Hotel. The annual winter pop-up once again transforms the hotel’s pool deck into a festive, palm-fringed wonderland featuring private ski huts & more

item.title: Stingrays Fans Toss 15,973 Stuffed Animals to the Ice in Annual Teddy Bear Toss
item.description: Just under six minutes into the 2nd period in Saturday night’s contest against the Greenville Swamp Rabbits, a crowd of 5,782 fans at the North Charleston Coliseum tossed 15,973 stuffed animals onto the ice for the Teddy Bear Toss

item.title: Fast-Casual Chicken Chain Super Chix Opens in West Ashley Dec. 9
item.description: A new fast-casual chicken restaurant is arriving in Charleston — Super Chix is opening Tuesday, Dec. 9 at 137 Savannah Hwy Ste. 630 in West Ashley.

item.title: Goo Goo Dolls to Perform at Credit One Stadium with Neon Trees in Aug. 2026
item.description: The Goo Goo Dolls will be performing at Credit One Stadium in Daniel Island on Saturday, Aug. 29, 2026 at 7 pm. They'll be joined by special guests Neon Trees. Tickets on sale this Friday, Dec. 12, 2025 at 10 a.m.

item.title: National Wreaths Across America Day to be Held at Old St. Andrews Church Dec. 13
item.description: Veterans are being honored this weekend on National Wreaths Across America (WAA) Day on Saturday, Dec.13, with the help of members from the Eliza Lucas Pinckney Chapter, NSDAR of Charleston.

item.title: The Charleston Museum to Commemorate America250 with Ringleaders of Rebellion: Charleston in Revolt, 1775–1783
item.description: The Charleston Museum will present a major special exhibition, Ringleaders of Rebellion: Charleston in Revolt, 1775–1783, on view January 31 through September 20, 2026.

item.title: Restore at Carolina Park to Host Oyster Roast Dec. 18
item.description: Restore at Carolina Park is excited to host an oyster roast on Thursday, Dec. 18, from 3 to 6 p.m. Residents and members of the public are invited to gather outdoors by the poolside cabanas at 1588 Bloom St. in Mount Pleasant

item.title: By The Way Announces New Culinary Leadership and Menu
item.description: By the Way (45½ Spring St.), the neighborhood restaurant and bar from Uptown Hospitality Group (UHG) and Southern Charm stars Craig Conover and Austen Kroll, is marking its one-year anniversary with a new culinary chapter.

item.title: Millers All Day Hosting ‘Christmas Vacation’ Pop-Up With Terrace Theater
item.description: Millers All Day has announced its second pop-up of the holiday season, partnering with Terrace Theater for an National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation-inspired event on Monday, Dec. 15 and again on Tuesday, Dec. 16 at 7 p.m.

item.title: Peach Cobbler Factory Set to Open Dessert Shop at 28 Woolfe St. in Charleston
item.description: The Peach Cobbler Factory, the fast-growing Southern dessert chain known for its warm fruit cobblers, banana puddings, cookies, churros and more, will soon open a new location at 28 Woolfe St. in Charleston.
